superAdmins.intro: Super admins hold the rules of your company's account and of every vault. Without the signers, they can change any of those rules, and so take money out of any vault. Who holds the account this site names for your company is read from the network, never from a list on this site. Your wallet checks the account is your company's when you act.
superAdmins.unnamed: This site's service did not name the company in a way your wallet can check, so its super admins cannot be read here. Reload the page; if it happens again, contact support.
superAdmins.noLink: This link does not name a company. Ask the super admin who sent it for the link again.
superAdmins.reading: Reading who holds your company from the network.
superAdmins.held.title: Who holds the company now
superAdmins.held.count: {count} keys hold it. This site and its service ask for {threshold} of them to sign a change; on the network's current version, any one of them can change it alone.
superAdmins.mine.title: Your key for this company
superAdmins.mine.one: Your key is one of the super admins.
superAdmins.mine.not-one: Your key is not one of the super admins. To be added, give this key to a super admin, who raises a change that adds it.
superAdmins.mine.refused: This browser would not copy your key. Select it in the field above and copy it by hand.
superAdmins.mine.use: Use my wallet's key for this company
superAdmins.warning.one-left: Only one key holds the company. If it is lost, nobody can ever change who holds the company's contracts again. Add another super admin while you can.
superAdmins.warning.every-needed: This site and its service ask for every super admin's key for a change. If any one is lost, no change can be made here again. Add another super admin, or ask for fewer of them, while you can.
superAdmins.lastKey: If every super admin's key is lost, nobody can ever change who holds the company's contracts again. Keep more than one super admin.
superAdmins.raise.title: Change the super admins
superAdmins.raise.what: Choose which keys stay, add the keys that join, and say how many this site and its service ask to sign a change. Each key that joins signs the change with its own wallet before anyone signs for a contract.
superAdmins.raise.add.hint: One key per line, as the joining person's page shows it under Your key for this company.
superAdmins.raise.unreadable: A key here is not one a wallet gives. Copy it again from the joining person's page.
superAdmins.raise.threshold: How many this site and its service ask to sign a change
superAdmins.change.title: A change in progress
superAdmins.change.after: After it: {count} keys, and this site and its service ask for {threshold} of them to sign a change.
superAdmins.change.join-waits: {key} joins, and has not signed yet.
superAdmins.done.kept: Your signature is in. Every super admin finds the change on this page. It is sent once enough of them have signed.
superAdmins.done.sent: Enough super admins have signed, and the change was sent.
superAdmins.why.raiser-leaves: This change takes your own key off, so your key cannot raise it. Another super admin raises it. If you are the only one, first raise a change that adds the other key and keeps yours; once that is done, the new super admin raises the change that takes yours off.
superAdmins.why.not-a-super-admin: Your key for this company is not one of its super admins yet, so it cannot raise or approve a change. If a change adds it, press Sign as a joining key on that change; otherwise give your key to a super admin.
superAdmins.why.joins-missing: Some joining keys have not signed the change yet, so no super admin signs for a contract. Each joining person opens this page from the link and presses Sign as a joining key.
superAdmins.why.no-change: That change is no longer kept: the company's account has changed since, or its raiser raised another change in its place. Read the page again; a super admin raises a new change if one is still needed.
superAdmins.why.not-installable: That change cannot be made: each key must be one a wallet gives for this company and be listed once, there must be at least one key, and the number who must sign is from 1 to the number of keys. Change the keys or the number and raise it again.
superAdmins.why.same-as-now: The company is already held by exactly these keys and this number, so there is nothing to change.
superAdmins.link.title: The link for a super admin with no seat
superAdmins.link.what: Send this to a super admin who is not a signer, or to a person you are adding. They open it signed in with their own wallet.
superAdmins.raise.anyOne: On the network's current version, the number you choose is held to by this site and its service only: any one super admin, with their own software, can change the company's contracts alone. Choose only people you would trust to do that.
superAdmins.done.held: Your signature is in. The change has not finished: {held}.
superAdmins.notAdopted.title: Vaults not yet adopted
superAdmins.notAdopted.what: The company created these vaults, and its account does not list them yet, so no change of the super admins names them and they stay held as they were created. Each is moved by the first change after the account lists it.
superAdmins.notAdopted.unseen: A vault the company created that its account does not list yet is left out of any change made here, and stays held as it was created. A signer of the company sees such vaults on this page.
